name: manual_822ea3
claim: Test fixtures that hand-build synthetic data instead of calling the real transformation function under test can hide production bugs that pass every test — verify test doubles call the actual function (e.g. the real redaction/serialization step), not a fixture shaped to match what the test author assumed the output would look like

decisions.notes: PortalNotificationPublisher.publish() read item.get('state') and expected a list, but the real redact_agents_payload() returns a dict ({'agents': [...], 'count': n}) keyed by 'status' not 'state'. Both plan tests passed because they monkeypatched redact_portal_status_payload with a hand-written fixture using the wrong field name AND the wrong (unwrapped) shape, instead of calling the real function. Found by an independent Claude subagent CEO-review voice that read actual source rather than trusting the plan's own self-review, which claimed full type consistency.
